normal.name: Ryan Bloom
normal.text: I liked video games a normal amount until I played the first Sonic. Not long after, I started wondering: How are games made? I eventually conscripted friends and we started trying to brainstorm our own Sonic game. We sent them to Sega via mail. When we got rejected, my friends gave up. I didn't.
